wiki.title: Shelley Funke Frommeyer
wiki.extract: Michelle Ann "Shelley" Frommeyer (born June 21, 1969) is an American politician from Kentucky. She is a member of the Republican Party and has represented District 24 in the Kentucky Senate since January 1, 2023. Frommeyer is a certified financial planner, and she resides in Alexandria, Kentucky.
